category_name: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
title: Supplication between Yemeni Corner and Black Stone
arabic: ﴿رَبَّنَا آتِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حسَنَةً وفي الآخِرَةِ حسَنةً وقِنَا عذَابَ النَّارِ﴾
transliteration: Rabbanā ātinā fid-dunyā ḥasanah wa fi 'l-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā `adhāban-nār
translation: Our Lord, grant us the good things in this world, and the good things in the next life, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
tags: Between the Yemeni corner and the black stone
